messages:
olivia_csm: Quick weekly health check for TesseraLabs — noticed p99 for streaming routes climbing week-over-week. Usage up 9%, spend within threshold but renewals team flagged tail risk. Can we triage? Link: https://redwood.internal/dash/tessera-health
liam_data: 24h snapshot:
- embed-search | streaming | p95=480ms (was 360ms), p99=1.8s (was 1.1s)
- embed-search | sync      | p95=230ms, p99=420ms
- doc-summarize | streaming | p95=700ms, p99=3.1s (notable spike 2026-03-17T22:13Z)
- doc-summarize | sync       | p95=320ms, p99=610ms
Raw query: https://redwood.internal/queries/10012
arjun_eng: Noted a model variant swap yesterday for summarize -> switched to `summarize-compact-q4` (quantized) to save cost. Quantization sometimes increases decode time for certain token patterns in streaming. Also saw a change in batching policy: `ENABLE_AGGRESSIVE_BATCHING=true` rolled in prod.
devon_sre: Observability: streaming sessions with the new variant show KV cache churn up 3x and slightly higher connection churn in eu-west-1 during spike window. No infra CPU/GPU saturation.
olivia_csm: Tessera's renewal PM needs a blurb on impact and our mitigation plan. Can we confirm root cause and ETA for mitigation? cc @arjun_eng @devon_sre
arjun_eng: Plan: rollback aggressive batching for streaming routes + revert model variant for canary. I'll run canary today and report. Expect preliminary results in ~45m.
latency-bot: Incident: TesseraLabs doc-summarize streaming p99 > 2s at 2026-03-17T22:13:09Z — created INC-4893
liam_data: Adding a short-lived dashboard widget showing p95/p99 by (route, model, mode) and a horizontal comparison of streaming vs sync; query: `SELECT route, model, mode, percentile_latency(0.95) AS p95, percentile_latency(0.99) AS p99 FROM inference_metrics WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY route, model, mode ORDER BY p99 DESC`
arjun_eng: Canary rollback executed on canary pool for streaming summarize. Monitoring 30m. Early read: doc-summarize streaming p99 down 3.1s -> 1.0s within 12m. p95 back to expected. Will prepare customer note once stable.
olivia_csm: Thanks — please post final lines I can share: brief cause, actions taken, and current status. Keeping this open until we confirm stable for 2h.
